recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for the current core build. If MedicationKnowledge is restored to core or maintained elsewhere, review FHIR-26536 with FHIR-31365, FHIR-50845, and FHIR-51149 so package-specific cost and package identifiers are represented in the active replacement model.
issue_request: FHIR-26536 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Pharmacy change request for R5 asking to make MedicationKnowledge packaging repeatable, add an identifier for a specific package, attach cost to packaging, and support searching the packaging-specific cost location.
initial_application: Historical FHIR-26536-tagged commits updated the MedicationKnowledge spreadsheet to add repeatable packaging, package identifier, packaging.cost as a content reference to the cost backbone, and packaging-cost search parameters. Later FHIR-31365 work refined the same family by making packaging.identifier and packaging.cost 0..*.
additional_context: MedicationKnowledge was later refactored so package details moved from inline packaging fields to MedicationKnowledge.packaging.packagedProduct referencing PackagedProductDefinition, while repeatable packaging.cost remained. Current source then removed MedicationKnowledge from active core resource/build metadata and the Medications module, and current CI build URLs for MedicationKnowledge return 404. FHIR-50845 and FHIR-51149 show the later Pharmacy direction to remove MedicationKnowledge and move formulary-based content to FormularyItem or other resources.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Editing residual source/medicationknowledge files would not correct a current built artifact because MedicationKnowledge is outside current build scope.

related_jiras.note: Refined FHIR-26536 by making MedicationKnowledge.packaging.identifier and MedicationKnowledge.packaging.cost repeatable; already represented on the combined branch.

Expanded FormularyItem with formulary-based MedicationKnowledge elements after the removal direction.
Later packaging-cost search parameter correction for MedicationKnowledge; already represented separately on the combined branch.
